Definition: Karmi, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Carmi = "my vineyard"; 1) the 4th son of Reuben and progenitor of the Carmites; 2) a Judaite, father of Achan, the 'troubler of Israel' in the time of Joshua
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
